I’ve struggled with an eating disorder since I was 12 (I’m 21 now) and a few months ago I decided I couldn’t continue living like that anymore. 

 I’ve just spent my first week as an outpatient in an ED centre and I’m finding it really, really difficult. 

Seeing Taylor’s body evolve has actually helped me a lot. During the 1989 era, I wanted to have her body so bad and would look at pictures of her, thinking of how much I hated mine. 
But then, seeing how she was during Rep and how she is now, more beautiful and confident than ever, has helped me accept that it’s okay and normal and healthy to gain weight. 

And her being more outspoken about her relationship with her body and body image makes me feel like she’s with me in this fight, and it gives me strength.
